set.body: Goal: add image display as a first-class renderer-neutral grammar primitive. Acceptance: immutable validated packed RGBA raster data with checked and unsafe construction; explicit nearest/smooth interpolation policy; anchored Grob.image placement lowered to a numeric DevicePrimitive; SVG, Canvas, and Java2D implementations preserve pixel orientation, alpha, z-order, clipping, and interpolation; semantic conformance plus independent pixel/XML/browser oracles pass on required JVM and Scala.js targets; no file IO, URLs, DOM image types, or Java image types enter shared graphics.
